title: Google Co-Founder Sergey Brin: Still Coding in 2024! #shorts
description: Retired in 2019, he owns 6% of a $4 trillion company and could live on a yacht for 40 years. Instead, he's programming 3-4 days a week, deep in the code, just like in Google's garage days. A true pattern of dedication. #TechTitan #CodingLife #Dedication #Billionaire
